You will work across system administration, database administration, troubleshooting, maintenance, monitoring, customer support, and eventually cloud infrastructure. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning how systems work, and taking ownership of customer environments. Team members are expected to validate outputs, protect customer and company information, and follow applicable security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Build a strong understanding of each assigned customer's environment, configuration, dependencies, and operational requirements. What We Are Looking For 3+ years of experience in technical support, system administration, managed services, infrastructure, database administration, or a related technical role; equivalent education and experience will also be considered. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise.
